passives.name: It’s Checkmate!
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Regina’s Miss chance is always increased by 10%, and upon entering battle, she gains an unremovable Regina’s World. (Trigger Effect) When an enemy attack results in a Miss, the cooldown of The Show Must Go On is reduced by [Buff_V_2000067_2_1] turns. When hit, she counterattacks the attacker. The damage of this skill increases based on her Critical Hit Chance (up to 50%).
